# `gcp.interconnectattachment`

Represents an InterconnectAttachment (VLAN attachment) resource. For more information, see Creating VLAN Attachments.

[compute](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | compute |
| Scope | regional |
| Asset type | `compute.googleapis.com/InterconnectAttachment` |
| Tier | 1 (ruled: post_create (post_create/interconnect_attachment.go.tmpl) is labels.tmpl's setLabels call, handled by the labels setter as on compute/Address, then a wait that re-reads until state leaves UNPROVISIONED. pre_delete (pre_delete/interconnect_attachment.go.tmpl) is the same wait before the DELETE. Both waits are GETs only.
THE BOUNDED GAP: create returns once the insert operation is done, not once the attachment is provisioned, so pairingKey and the router addresses may be empty until a later refresh. A delete sent while still UNPROVISIONED is not waited for; if Google refuses it, the error is Google's and a retry converges.
) |
| Mutation timeout | 600s |
